acme_prod: Hey @maya_cs — after yesterday's rollout to v2.7 we started seeing intermittent 503s on the /v1/generate route and our order-summary output now consistently ends with a weird 'Note:' prefix. This started ~2026-03-16T02:30Z. Can you help?

maya_cs: Sorry to hear that, @acme_prod. We rolled a canary of v2.7 yesterday at 02:14 UTC and promoted later. Can you share a couple of example request IDs and a minimal prompt that reproduces the changed summary style? Also confirm which model+version you're hitting and the route (e.g., `/v1/generate` vs `/v1/chat`).

raj_engineer: Adding @liz_oncall and SRE. Two things to get us moving: 1) prompt logs (raw prompt + system/meta) for the failing requests; 2) any request-level headers you can share (x-request-id, x-customer-id, x-deployment-region). If you can provide a tiny repro snippet that we can run locally that would be ideal. Example curl we need (include exact headers):

```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'x-request-id: 9c1a2f3b' \n  -d '{"model":"open-variants/longsmall-v1","input":"<your prompt here>","max_tokens":200}'
```

liz_oncall: Noted. From SRE side: please also include timestamps for the 503s and whether they coincide with spikes in request concurrency. We saw a brief uptick in 5xxs during the canary window but rolled a minor patch the same day. If you can supply the last 3 x-request-ids that returned 503 we can pull the backend traces. Also, do you see higher p50/p95 latency from your end?

acme_prod: Thanks. One example request id that returned 503: `req-20260316-7f9a` (2026-03-16T02:37:12Z). Minimal prompt that shows the style drift attached below. We also saw the 'Note:' prefix on ~70% of order-summary responses after the deploy.

Example (we redacted tokens):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xoxp-acme-987' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'x-request-id: req-20260316-7f9a' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct/1.2.0","input":"Order items: 2x T-shirt ($20), 1x Mug ($10). Produce a short customer-facing order summary.","max_tokens":80}'
```

Observed response body (truncated):

```json
{"id":"resp-xxxx","output":"Your order: 2 T-shirts, 1 Mug. Total $50. Note:"}
```

maya_cs: Perfect, this is exactly what we needed. Please DM any sensitive logs or upload to the secure support bucket link I just sent via DM. We'll open a high-priority ticket and include request ids.

deploy-bot: deploy v2.7 -> v2.7.1 promoted by @eng-release at 2026-03-16T04:10:08Z (canary rollback not triggered).

raj_engineer: Thanks @acme_prod. Two hypotheses to check in parallel: 1) a prefix-caching change in the serving runtime that might trim trailing punctuation/append a 'Note:' when fallback kernels are used; 2) a race condition causing intermittent 503s under certain batching sizes. @liz_oncall can you pull p95/p99 and kernel-fallback traces for route `/v1/generate` around 02:30-03:00Z? Also please fetch the model variant list for `redwood-instruct/1.2.0` — we may have routed to a quantized variant during canary.

liz_oncall: On it. I'll also check autoscaler logs and per-GPU queue lengths. If we find a correlation with batching thresholds we'll try a config revert for the batcher.

acme_prod: I'm going to package the last 24h of prompt logs and upload them to the secure link in ~30m. We'll include a couple more failing x-request-ids and the full response bodies. Appreciate the quick triage.

sam_support: Thanks @acme_prod — appreciated. We'll follow up in the ticket with next steps and an ETA for a fix or rollback. :thumbsup:
